name: Statistics for Public Policy
description: Ordinary least squares; bivariate linear regression model; multivariate regression model (Gauss Markov theorem, inference and prediction, irrelevant variables); interpretation of coefficients and hypotheses testing; real world issues (multicollinearity, heteroskedasticity, endogeneity bias, measurement error); correlation versus causation; panel data.
